name: Mobile Brain
what: Mobile Brain is an AI deep tech in computational neuroscience democratizing access to cognitive assessments by turning spontaneous speech into objective metrics. Using graph theory and NLP, we enable early screening and longitudinal monitoring for cognitive and emotional health across schools, healthcare, and enterprises—bridging the gap between the first signs and timely clinical care.
